subject.title: perf(gateway): share one node.list snapshot across session catalog providers

question: Should the request-owned `listNodes` callback become the approved session-catalog provider SDK contract, rather than remaining an internal Gateway-only optimization seam?
rationale: The patch is additive and preserves fallback behavior, but it introduces a new provider-list API that external plugins could adopt; that permanent boundary requires maintainer intent rather than an inferred implementation choice.

options.title: Approve the additive provider callback
options.body: Accept `listNodes` as the documented request-lifetime catalog-provider capability and retain the fallback for providers called outside Gateway catalog requests.

options.title: Keep node lookup internal
options.body: Rework the optimization so the Gateway shares prepared node facts without exposing a new public provider-list callback.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive provider callback
recommendation.body: Accept `listNodes` as the documented request-lifetime catalog-provider capability and retain the fallback for providers called outside Gateway catalog requests.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently introduced the adjacent request-owned catalog snapshot pattern and authored this proposed SDK extension.
